level1: Bring a creature to its knees, then press F beside it to take its spirit.
The flags bank what you carry. Fall before the next one and it is lost.
Tide quenches Ember. The old lizard at the road's end burns hot.
level2: The shore is thick with Tide and Gale creatures, and Volt in the storms.
Umbra swallows Tide. Bring something dark for the whale.
When the sky rains shot, stand in the gaps.
level3: Nothing in the hollow is young. Expect grown creatures from the first step.
Gale scatters Umbra. Bring a strong wind for the moth.
Its ring of shot turns each time it fires. Watch where the gap moves.
